breakfast.name: Ham broccoli egg muffins
steps: On Sunday, heat the oven to 350 F and spray a 12-cup muffin tin well.
Divide the ham, broccoli, and bell pepper among the cups.
Whisk the eggs, cottage cheese, garlic powder, salt, and pepper, then pour into the cups about three-quarters full.
Top with the cheddar and bake 20 to 22 minutes until set in the center.
Cool, then refrigerate in a sealed container.
To serve, microwave 2 muffins per person for 45 to 60 seconds and eat with a clementine or two.

lunch.name: Strawberry-mango smoothie
ingredients: Optional: 1/2 frozen banana, a squeeze of lime, or a few ice cubes
steps: Add almond milk and yogurt to the blender first.
Add protein powder, spinach, strawberries, mango, almond butter, and flaxseed.
Blend on high 45 to 60 seconds until smooth, adding a splash of water if too thick.
Pour into two glasses and drink right away.

dinner.name: Lemon-herb chicken sheet pan
ingredients: 1 1/4 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut in 1 1/2-inch pieces
1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, rinsed and patted dry
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and line a large sheet pan.
Toss chickpeas, zucchini, red onion, and tomatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper and roast 10 minutes.
Toss the chicken with the remaining oil, lemon zest, garlic, oregano, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the chicken to the pan and roast 15 minutes until it reaches 165 F.
Squeeze the lemon juice over everything, sprinkle with feta, and serve.

breakfast.name: Choc PB overnight oats
ingredients: 1 scoop chocolate or vanilla protein powder
steps: The night before, whisk almond milk, Greek yogurt, protein powder, and cocoa until smooth.
Stir in the oats, chia seeds, and peanut butter, divide between two jars, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, stir, add a splash of milk if thick, and top with the banana slices.

dinner.name: Garlic shrimp + spaghetti squash
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined (thawed if frozen)
steps: Halve the squash lengthwise and scoop out the seeds. Set the halves cut side down in a microwave-safe dish with 2 tbsp water and microwave 10 to 12 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile, pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat, add garlic and pepper flakes for 30 seconds, then add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side until pink.
Scrape the squash into strands with a fork and add to the skillet with the spinach, tossing 1 to 2 minutes until the spinach wilts.
Squeeze in the lemon, top with Parmesan, and serve.

dinner.name: Chicken taco soup
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook the onion and peppers 5 minutes until softened.
Add garlic, chili powder, and cumin and cook 30 seconds.
Add broth, black beans, tomatoes, and corn, bring to a boil, then simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the chicken and simmer 5 minutes more, then season with lime juice, salt, and pepper.
Serve half topped with avocado and cheddar, and refrigerate the other half for Saturday lunch.

dinner.name: Garlic sirloin + mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, about 1 inch thick
steps: Pat the steak dry and season well with salt and pepper.
Add the green beans and 1/4 cup water to a large skillet, cover, and steam 4 minutes over medium-high heat, then move to a plate.
Wipe the skillet, heat the olive oil until shimmering, and sear the steak 4 to 5 minutes per side to 130 F for medium-rare. Rest it on a board.
Lower the heat to medium, add the butter, mushrooms, and thyme, and cook 5 minutes until browned, then add garlic for 30 seconds and toss the green beans back in.
Slice the steak against the grain and serve with the mushrooms and green beans.

dinner.name: Parmesan haddock + asparagus
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and line a sheet pan.
Toss asparagus and tomatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper and spread on the pan.
Mix Parmesan, panko, garlic powder, lemon zest, and the remaining oil in a small bowl.
Pat the fish dry, set it on the pan, brush the tops with Dijon, and press on the crumb mixture.
Roast 12 to 15 minutes until the fish flakes easily, then squeeze lemon over everything and serve.

breakfast.name: Spinach feta omelets
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and wilt the spinach and tomatoes 1 to 2 minutes, then set aside.
Add the remaining oil and half the eggs, swirl, and cook about 2 minutes until nearly set.
Spoon half the spinach, tomatoes, and feta on one side, fold, and slide onto a plate. Repeat for the second omelet.
Serve with the strawberries.

lunch.name: Leftover chicken taco soup
steps: Reheat the soup in a pot over medium heat for 5 to 8 minutes, stirring, until steaming.
Divide between two bowls and top with avocado, a spoon of Greek yogurt, and a squeeze of lime.

dinner.name: Mini turkey meatloaves
ingredients: 1/4 cup no-sugar-added ketchup (half for the glaze)
steps: Heat the oven to 400 F, spray 6 cups of a muffin tin, and line a sheet pan.
Mix turkey, egg, oats, onion, 2 tbsp ketchup, Worcestershire, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper, then pack into the 6 cups and brush the tops with the remaining ketchup.
Toss broccoli and carrots with olive oil, salt, and pepper on the sheet pan.
Bake both together 20 to 22 minutes until the meatloaves reach 165 F and the vegetables are browned.
Rest the meatloaves 3 minutes, then serve with the vegetables.

breakfast.name: Yogurt parfaits + eggs
steps: Cover the eggs with cold water in a pot, bring to a boil, then turn off the heat, cover, and let sit 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, layer yogurt, blueberries, granola, and almonds in two glasses or bowls and dust with cinnamon.
Move the eggs to ice water for 2 minutes, peel, and serve 2 per person with the parfaits.

lunch.name: Tuna white bean salad
ingredients: 2 cans (5 oz) tuna in water, drained
steps: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Add tuna, beans, cucumber, tomatoes, and red onion and toss gently.
Top with feta and serve.

dinner.name: Dijon pork chops + cabbage
ingredients: 2 boneless pork loin chops (about 6 oz each, 1 inch thick)
1/2 small green cabbage, cut in 4 wedges
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and line a large sheet pan.
Brush the cabbage wedges and carrots with 1 1/2 tbsp olive oil, season with salt and pepper, and roast 15 minutes.
Whisk Dijon, honey, vinegar, thyme, garlic powder, and the remaining oil, and rub most of it over the chops.
Flip the cabbage, add the chops to the pan, and roast 12 to 15 minutes until the pork reaches 145 F.
Rest the chops 3 minutes, drizzle the rest of the Dijon mixture over the cabbage, and serve.
